ratio_definition: Sole retained original nine-hour N1 wall time divided by the current image own nine-hour wall time; an unpaired descriptive ratio, not an isolated or repeatable causal speedup.

targets.interpretation: A positive gap is the required further reduction in CURRENT wall time; it is not measured headroom or a guarantee.
